verdict.rationale: Rainforest documents two credential types—long-lived API keys for server-to-server auth and short-lived (max 24h) session tokens used in embedded components—which shows a scoping/least-privilege credential model, but nothing ties this explicitly to issuing credentials for an AI agent's use. Missing for 10: agent-specific credential scoping (e.g., per-permission or per-task API keys), documentation framing credentials for autonomous/agentic access, and any mention of AI agent use cases.
